purpose: User-requested descriptive extension of the frozen Monster candidate; no model, feature, threshold, or selection tuning.
known_calibration_mismatch: 2024-06 generated 30 tail rows versus 37 frozen-cache rows; tail_p maximum absolute difference 0.03175835206146238. Keep XGBoost 3.4.1, do not search versions or alter gates to force a match, and label 2022/2026 as runtime-sensitive source reconstruction.

years.2022: Full calendar-year retrospective diagnostic; later-derived fixed gates mean this is not OOS.
years.2026: Partial year from 2026-01-01 through the last frozen daily-data date; forward outcomes unavailable after that date remain unresolved. Report only, no tuning.

reconstruction.algorithm: Same v9.score_tail_month recipe: v7.model, y_top025, base.FEATURES, v7.cdf, monthly retraining.
reconstruction.train_purge: target_end_date strictly earlier than model-month start.
reconstruction.eligible_universe: base.eligible_rows with price_cap=1000; prev_volume>=10000, volume>=5000, close>=20, prev_close<=1000 and all base.FEATURES present.
reconstruction.prediction_rows: All eligible feature rows in the month, including recent rows with immature forward labels; those labels are excluded from scoring and used only for post-score evaluation.

candidate_policy.pool: tail_cdf>=0.999 AND previous official XTKS-session market median ret5<=0 AND signal-date ret10<=0.5735294117647058.
candidate_policy.daily_limit: None; emit all qualifying non-cooldown candidates.
candidate_policy.cooldown: Same symbol detected on immediately previous official XTKS session; 2026 year boundary seeded from the frozen 2025-12-30 candidate cache.
candidate_policy.target: Next official XTKS open through fifth official XTKS close including entry, canonical daily-OHLCV labels.

predeclared_check.rule: Compare generated tail-gate date/symbol set to frozen cache; tail_cdf exact and tail_p absolute difference <=1e-9.
predeclared_check.drift: If mismatch, retain results only as same-source reconstruction with runtime sensitivity disclosed; do not tune to force a match.

use_of_results: Report only. Do not promote/reject/tune any candidate using these annual results. Original frozen spec and report remain unchanged.
